name: Singleton<T>
src_typeComment: Generic MonoBehaviour singleton. Inherit as: public class GameManager : Singleton<GameManager>  The constraint is `where T : Singleton<T>` (the curiously recurring pattern), NOT `where T : MonoBehaviour`. With the looser constraint, `class Foo : Singleton<Bar>` compiled happily and then `this as T` silently evaluated to null at runtime, leaving Instance permanently empty with nothing to explain why. This way that mistake will not compile.
